note: Written before any KEY.json was opened. Identity was not blind in practice: one set is always the landscape lantern-gun shooter; the podium frames are portrait third-person or a racer. Judged on look anyway.

pair_01.why: R: warm textured boardwalk and cobbles, even with a pole across camera. L: one flat-black spiked blob in lilac fog, a huge NODES OPEN banner, no world visible.

pair_02.why: L: a real valley with sketch-hatched cypresses and houses and a painted tree, a concept you can read. R: cohesive but a flat floor and a tutorial-era framing. L loses points for a muddy smeared ground and faceted octahedron foliage.

pair_03.why: R: one committed style (toon, halftone, LED HUD, sunset). L: decent bridge and flowers, but a black camera-clip wedge on the left edge and a washed grey sky.

pair_04.why: R: dense, composed, one-palette village square with NPCs. L: a flat-black untextured giant fills 60% of the frame, no shading, no edge, looks like a missing material.

pair_05.why: L: authored wood and costume materials, though cropped hero and text panel. R: almost entirely white snow-like plane with a brown patch and a shouty BLOOMSTORM banner; sketch buildings far off are the only detail.

pair_06.why: R: a distinct ink-sketch world with tower, arcade and hatched cypresses; reads as an idea. L: a tutorial panel over the hero. R's foreground cypresses are giant flat grey slabs though.

pair_07.why: R: SUNDRIFT's committed grade and chrome. L: blank white slope, a title card as the main content, nothing to look at.

pair_08.why: L: textured stone and a well-dressed hero. R: same black blob in fog, banner text, bottom caption bar; no environment.

pair_01.why: L: houses, hatched trees, painted-vs-sketch contrast. R: bare purple dune, wooden 2x4 block for a gun.

pair_02.why: L: bridge, flowers, depth. R: grey blob trees, blue slabs, block gun.

pair_03.why: Both weak. L: flat-black giant is cheap. R: black square z-fight/particle artifacts, block gun, untextured enemy. L's ground and gun at least read authored.

pair_04.why: L: sketch town with a painted patch. R: empty green field and a block gun.

pair_05.why: L: tower, arcade, hatching. R: empty pink dune with distant boxes.

pair_06.why: R: sparse, but the lantern gun and hatched chalk read made. L: flat grey wall at point blank, block gun.

pair_01.why: R: inked linework, warm light, layered vista. L: soft grey 3D with blurry ground, no linework at all.

pair_02.why: R: paint bursting from a kill into ink, stone walls, lineart. L: no visible kill colour, generic 3D.

pair_03.why: L: bridge, mill, readable skull creature. R: black untextured giant.

pair_04.why: R: arcaded market with ink spire. L: empty white plane.

pair_05.why: R: windmills, flyers, golden hour. L: grey hill, slab cypresses.

pair_06.why: R: chapel and horned boss. L: blank chalk slope and title.
